repo.description:
### Impact

A SSRF vulnerability found that enables access to internal Chrome Devtools Protocol APIs that can leak the JWT authentication token for another user.
A low privileged attacker could continually exploit this vulnerability to leak the JWT authentication token for another user when they start a recording, which then enables the attacker read/write access to the victim's Whiteboard.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Whiteboard is upgraded to 1.5.8.

### Workarounds

* Disable app Whiteboard

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3576823)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/whiteboard/pull/1196)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: SSRF on Nextcloud Whiteboard Application via Recordings to Unauthorised Access to Whiteboards
